summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on fraud/security, regulation.

articles.title: Kroger’s AI focus is on ‘flexibility and control’
articles.description: From bridging the digital and physical shopping worlds to further ramping effective personalization, the grocer’s chief digital officer delved into the company’s priorities.

articles.title: FIDO wrestles with agentic trust
articles.description: The industry consortium and payments players are considering standards for agentic commerce, particularly for verifying identity.

articles.title: ACH use rises for B2B payments
articles.description: The automated clearing house payments have multiplied to overtake paper checks as the most popular form of business-to-business payments, according to a new Federal Reserve report.

articles.title: Moov adds P2P competition
articles.description: Using Mastercard and Visa’s digital infrastructure, the tool facilitates peer-to-peer payments without requiring both parties to have the same app.

articles.title: Pentair picks up ex-Fiserv CFO
articles.description: Former Fiserv CFO Bob Hau is stepping into Pentair’s top finance seat as it seeks to close a $1.4 billion acquisition of Taco Group.

articles.title: How digital IDs may battle fraud
articles.description: Americans are vulnerable to identification and payment frauds because the U.S. has been slow to adopt digital identification, two Congress members said.

articles.title: Amazon blocks Meta’s AI shopper
articles.description: The e-commerce giant said Meta had failed to notify it about the Muse agent accessing its retail site to make purchases on behalf of consumers.

articles.title: Adyen snaps up Klarna CFO
articles.description: The Dutch digital payments processor has hired Niclas Neglen as its new chief financial officer, but he won’t join until next year.
